title: The coefficient morphism $\eta_f$
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a condensed ring and $f\colon X\to Y$ a morphism of schemes.
The morphism
$$
\eta_f\colon\Lambda_Y\longrightarrow f_*f^*\Lambda_Y\xrightarrow{\ f_*\alpha_f\ }f_*\Lambda_X
$$
is the unit of the adjunction $f^*\dashv f_*$
([def-sfb-finite-upper-lower-star-adjunction]) followed by $f_*$ of $\alpha_f$
([def-sfb-alpha]). In other words, it is the mate of $\alpha_f$.
Here $\Lambda_X$ and $\Lambda_Y$ are the pulled-back coefficient objects of [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and the adjunction is taken on sheaves of abelian groups on the small pro-étale sites.

lean.note: Exact existing declaration in the published upstream pro-etale module-object framework, confirmed by scompile.py --source. In the section Λ is a sheaf on coherentTopology Profinite.{u} with values in Ab.{u + 1}, with ring structure [MonObj Λ], and f : X ⟶ Y is arbitrary for X Y : Scheme.{u}. Its body is (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction Ab.{u + 1} f).unitAlgHom (condensedRingObj Λ Y) followed by lowerStar.map (condensedPullbackHom Λ f). Adjunction.unitAlgHom is an abbreviation of adj.unit.app, so this is exactly the required unit followed by pushforward of alpha_f, equivalently its adjunction mate. No finiteness, commutativity, or morphism-property hypothesis is imposed. The branch label denotes the published WeilConjectures source root, resolved by the side overlay rather than the older local source checkout.
